item.title: First thoughts after watching Re:Zero season 4 episode 10
item.description:
I watched the Re:Zero season 4 episode 10. I remember the story for season 2 and 3 only a little, but don't remember the details of each character that much. This note includes a spoiler.

Subaru was surprised that Meili was dead on the floor and he obviously killed her, but he didn't remember what happened. So he hid her under a podium and left the room. Then Emilia came to him and worried about him and he wondered how kind she was to him. He was basically shut-in who couldn't do anything before coming to the world, so no wonder. Then Ram came to them, and she asked them to go to the archive where Baeko was there.

Baeko found out the dead book of Meili. They discussed who would read it, and Baeko suggested it should be either Subaru or Julius. And, why? They didn't have mana that much? Subaru may not be necessary for Reid but Julius should, so I don't get why she suggested them, instead of Ram or Emilia. Emilia was hesitant to read the book but Shaula suggested reading it, as if she doesn't care people's deaths. Probably she killed people so many so far, lives are nothing special for her, obviously. Then as suggested, Subaru read the book.

The book was of course about Meili's life. She was picked up by a wolf. It's weird that the wolf didn't eat her but well, it's a fantasy. Then Elsa came and she kills her parents, wolves, and Elsa picked up Meili. She was brought to her mother, who was the Sin Archbishop who can change their forms in the season 3. I forgot her name nor which one her sin was. Anyway, she traveled around with Elsa, and she killed people without any hesitation anywhere, and she was surprised and frightened. Well, naturally, because it might've been her turn next. But then Elsa was gone, and actually, she still didn't learn how to show emotions. She was just trying to immitate Elsa until then. Then Subaru found her, and brought her to the tower. So, for her, the village's issue wasn't the serious nor important thing she wanted to remember. She wanted to find something in the archive, but Subaru found her and she avoided him. Who's book she wanted to find? Elsa? Anyway, then somehow she didn't want to be found by anyone and be known, so wanted to do something against him. And next time, he was in the archive, and was reading books. But then he said something to her. It was obviously not Subaru. Did he find and read a gospel and became one of Sin Archbishops? Then next day, she talked about what he said while he was the Archbishop, and the that man killed her. So, that means, before he lost the memory, he became that man, and even after he lost his memory, he still was that man.

After reading the Meili's book, he was so shocked, confused, and couldn't talk. Because he was so afraid of being found that he killed her, he saw an illusion of her and heard her voice from her illusion. Everyone avoided reading the book because he was unable to react and respond, except that Shaula seemed to know what he did. And then, they couldn't find her body, and they decided not to find it anymore.

It was so shocked for Subaru, so at night, he left the spirit room and tried to shut up Patrasche. And he wanted to confirm if there was a body, and it lost. Then Ram came to the place, and found out Subaru wasn't him. Then he was so on the edge, he almost made up his mind to kill her to hide it. Because the illusion he was seeing said to him that murder became a habit to solve another problem once that person had succeeded to do so. But this is the end of the episode.

The body lost because I guess Ram knew he killed and the body was there, because she called him and Emilia, and didn't want others to look it. Maybe Foxidna also knew it. Other people couldn't hide anything with straight faces so these were only people who were suspicious, other than Shaula. Obviously, Ram has an ability to look someone through the Mabeast, so used it to Patrasche and followed him, and showed Subaru the same gesture as he had done to Patrasche against him.

Well, it was fun, but nothing is clear yet, and the next episode is the final episode in the season 4, or at least in the part of this season. Do I need to wait for a long time for what will happen? Really?

Watched 2nd time.

Did Subaru become the other Sin Archbishop like when he did during Petelgeus? It seemed not, but I couldn't say for sure. I noticed why Subaru started questioning about himself, because from his perspective, Subaru with his own memory was the person who was murder of Meili and seemed to do the same thing against other people like Emilia or Baeko. So in the later episode, what the illusion Subaru saw looks like Meili said and behaved basically the Subaru's inner thought and just talked to him. Also, Subaru was so afraid of being found out, cameras often pointed out necks who he targeted.

In terms of why/how the Meili body wasn't found, I bet Shaula hid it. Shaula noticed Subaru did something to Meili somehow, so that's why. Why did she notice about it was unclear, though. She hadn't known the archive before Subaru came, so she didn't know the dead book must include the moment when a person is dead or not. She may be able to figure out who is lying or not?

Another unclear thing was, when Ram was trying to find Meili, she came to the spirit room, saw Rem's body, and found out about something. What was that about? Was there anything suspicious? No idea.

Then thinking back who killed Subaru in the 1st or 2nd loop in the tower, I guess it was likely Meili. Ram could be if she could've found out Subaru could be the Sin ArchBishop, but she didn't and also asked questions to him and wanted him not to lose the memory. Meili could have done it because, in this memory, she said she didn't want to be seen in the archive but he saw her, so she pushed him to avoid being noticed. Subaru allowed do whatever she wanted, and that might be the one she wanted? No, not pretty make sense, but could be

item.title: First thoughts after watching Re:Zero season 4 episode 9
item.description:
I watched the Re:Zero season 4 episode 9. I remember the story for season 2 and 3 only a little, but don't remember the details of each character that much. This note includes a spoiler.

This episode was the best one in the season 4. So we figured out who was the main heroine. Patrasche. Period.

Subaru went outside of the tower, and faced a sand worm. I think this was owned by Meili. Right before he was eaten, it was killed by Shaula's magics. I thought she would attack him next, but instead, he fell down into the quicksand. He didn't even see her at all.

Then he went to the underground again, and walked to the right side of the crosswalk, and hit the 3rd wall. He couldn't open the gate, but somehow, the gate lit up and he was moved to the watchtower. Why? There was no hint so no idea. Maybe because he was the only one and he was the master of Shaula?

It seemed he went nuts again, or maybe he went to pieces because of the pressure that he would be killed by others, so he talked himself to persuade him to kill others. That was exactly what happened to him when he faced to Petelgeus. He thought he was able to kill someone who had killed him no matter who, though he had no ability to do so, and he knew it, so he was kinda. arrogant?

Then when he went to the upstairs, the first thing he saw was Shaula's dead body. So, because he pretended to be strong, he was frightened about that and thought she wasn't the one. I was anticipating some ugly mabeast from Shaula would come and kill him. Actually, the subtitle of this episode is Empty shell, so it was perhaps about her in this scene.

Then he looked around and found many dead bodies. Ram was dead in front of the chair which Rem sit and which Ram pushed, and she had something on her back, or maybe her back was cut through. It was, perhaps, in the spirit room? Then Meili and Julius was dead in the same room. Don't know where. Maybe the room where they ate a meal. Why didn't Julius be with Foxidna? Then Foxidna was dead below the downstairs of the 2nd floor. The blood of the downstairs looked like the previous episode when Subaru was pushed from the downstairs, so she was killed by him?

Subaru couldn't find Emilia and Beako, but then found Patrasche. He stabbed his broken sword into her body, but she didn't say a single thing, and he lost his word, and he curled up his knee and sat against the wall, saying that he wanted to be alone. Then some sand storm came from the downstairs. Maybe Shaula? Then Patrasche took him and went around while bleeding, and she pushed him to the secret passage and pushed to the skydeck. She was probably killed that sandstorm. Then he was shouting there, and then, he was pushed by someone. That person told him to try again, hero, or something like that, by the voice and the cut scene of Rem. Well, what does this mean? It sounded like this person knew that he returned by death, and also they called him the hero, like Rem. The person who knew he was able to try again was, the Witch and Roswaal only, and used the body of Rem? Did she cause the sand storm in the tower? Not so sure, I feel not because she approached him without any noise. Then why did she wake up, or how could that person take her body? Shaula caused the Witch to wake up? Or maybe because he couldn't find Emilia, she actually climbed up to the watchtower, and did something, and that caused Rem to wake up as the Witch? Beako was... where? Maybe dead? But then, who was killed by a Rem, and who was by Shaula? Ram seemed to be by Rem, because she was near her chair. Not sure others.

That was not the end. So in the next Subaru, he was trying not to tell the fact that he lost his memory, and tried to collect information. He trusted Patrasche only and also Shaula and talked with Julius about what happened in the previous day. It kinda seemed a wrong person to pick up and trusted but he was confused more because Julius didn't want to talk to him because what bothered him was that Subaru hid the secret about Foxidna from him. Then he gave a reward to her by a hug, after she demanded a lot like a child. What is this woman anyway? Elf?

Then he started talking to Meili, and she talked about something happened in the previous day. Then king crimson again. The scene was moved, they were somewhere, probably in the archive, and Subaru thought he killed her. And in his left arm, there was a scar saying that Subaru was coming. I wasn't sure what happened, really. Was it a magic, or why did he lose his memory that short amount of time? I was thinking Meili was the one who attacked him and stole his memory somehow, but she wasn't? Who else? The other suspicious person was Gluttony as it's in the opening, but never appeared yet. No idea what happens.

Watched the 2nd time. When a sandworm attacked Subaru and Shaula protected him, maybe she actually didn't try to kill him as he was the master. Instead, she reacted every single thing other than him and tried to kill them. Then when he went back to the tower, and then someone pushed him. I didn't recognize in English dub, but in the original Japanese audio, how to talk was completely different from Rem. It seemed that... that person was a certain someone, but may be not in the Re:Zero. Or was it actually one of the Sin Archbishop who can mutate their body, which attacked Priestella in the Season 3? I don't know. But then what did she mean about "try again"? hero makes sense because he called himself hero in the town. If this were true, someone in the group was actually that woman, maybe Meili. Maybe Meili was dead when they entered into the tower and joined to Subaru? But then what did it mean that they lived with their parents?

Then, Subaru talked to Julius and Julius's pathetic feeling that Anastasia may forget him hit me. Because Subaru didn't know that Julius was nameless and no way to know it, it was painful.

Also, Meili talked with Subaru that they lived with Elsa. Wasn't that name the assassin who came to a royal town and in the Mathers' Mansion? Anyhow, then this Meili was an imposter and maybe the Sin Archibishop?

Well, if this is that woman, then why did the opening show Gluttony, though lol

item.title: First thoughts after watching Re:Zero season 4 episode 8
item.description:
I watched the Re:Zero season 4 episode 8. I remember the story for season 2 and 3 only a little, but don't remember the details of each character that much. This note includes a spoiler.

This episode was the best one in the season 4. At first, Subaru lost his memory, and talked to Emilia and Beako about it. Then he also met other people and was surprised by that fact. Julius was so upset about it and he couldn't even introduce himself to Subaru. Ram didn't believe about that fact and asked him in a different place. She was so upset and sad at the same time. I don't know how Ram felt about Rem, but at least Subaru was the only one who knew Rem before she went to sleep. So, that means nobody in the world knew her anymore. Then he and Julius introduced about themselves. Also, Foxidna introduced herself to other people, though at least Emilia noticed she was a spirit. I guessed it was because she contracted with a spirit, Pack. Ram was surprised, though.

Because they found Subaru fell down in the archive in the 3rd floor and he lost all of his memory in the world, everyone but Subaru went to the archive. He was walking around in the tower and was trying to figure out if he has some abilities like he did in the 1st episode in the 1st season. But then, someone pushed him and he fell down to the 1st floor and died.

Then he returned by death to the green spirit room. I was wondering what happened by this, and now, it returned after his memory was lost. So, he didn't know anything about Return by death, and was confused with the situation, just like he did in the 1st season. But he easily figured it out from the fact that everyone had the same conversations and they didn't know he was able to return. He got a chip on his shoulder because he didn't take any diary and couldn't figure out what happens. But it kinda makes sense because he couldn't tell or share anything about it so it won't help that much. Also, who can predict he lost only part of his memory. Actually, why did he lose only part of his memory? Because gluttony can eat only those in the world?

Anyway, then he wanted to tell about this ability, but he eavesdropped that they try not to join him in his group and he wanted to leave. Then he fell down to the tower, again. Who did it? There was a voice just before he fell down, but I couldn't recognize the voice. Meili? Foxidna?

Then he was very afraid of anyone because he didn't know who did it. After he woke up in his 3rd life, he jumped from the stone, ran to a random place, which was in front of Reid, but didn't say anything to him, and Reid pushed him to the downstairs. He was almost dead, but then the Witch came and saved him. Well, why and how could she come? He even didn't see her so probably he didn't recognize her. She came because the place was exactly like the graveyard? Or can she come only when he was about to be dead, but she couldn't save from the death? But she hadn't come until that time except the graveyard, so didn't totally make sense.

Anyway, Subaru survived, and others were really upset and Ram went ballistic and didn't want Subaru near Rem. Then he wanted to get out of the tower as soon as possible, so he left from the 1st floor. That was because he didn't know he was under an exam and the rule was he couldn't leave until the exam was solved. So Shaula was changed and she was going to go berserk, and before what happened, the episode ended.

The biggest question to me was, what could he do? I think he was dead again, and then Emilia will help him and got out of the situation. But the problem was 1. how to recover his memory and 2. who pushed Subaru and why, and 3. how to overcome the exam on the 2nd floor. No clue for the 1st problem. The 2nd point was because someone didn't believe him, maybe Meili, and thought it was a good timing to kill him? Then 3rd was... Subaru got his memory back and figure out how to win against Reid from the book he read, I guess.

That said, there were only 3 episodes in this arc, so will they finish this tower's arc in the season 4?

Watched the 2nd time.

When the Witch came, Subaru noticed her. I think the Witch appeared because he was alone and there was no risk being seen by anyone else. The voice when Subaru was despairing was... who? Was it himself, just like he laughed at himself in season 1 just before being killed by Pack in the Petelgeus's episode?

Also, Meili said that he let his guard down the previous day, so I'm sure she was someone related to losing his memory. Then, probably she was the one who pushed him. But she was in the conversation just before Subaru fell down on the 2nd time, so she may not be?

In terms of animation, Shaula's eyes had 3 red highlights, but when Subaru left the tower, those highlights changed to 3 pupils. Were they made by magic or something, maybe.

item.title: First thoughts after watching Re:Zero season 4 episode 7
item.description:
I watched the Re:Zero season 4 episode 7. I remember the story for season 2 and 3 only a little, but don't remember the details of each character that much.

I was wondering what this subtitle was about, and this turned out to be an episode with a cliffhanger. At first, Subaru talked to Julius and Julius decided to watch over Echidna, or Foxidna. Then Subaru went back to a room with Emilia, Ram, Beako, Meili, and Shaula, and then planned to talk about the fight. But then he was hungry so they started having a meal. Apparently, Beako and Shaula don't need to eat food at all. Also Beako held Subaru's hand but she blushed because that was from her anxiety, and that childishness was so cute.

Then Subaru went to the green room and took over from Julius for watching over because of Rem, and also, Julius didn't know how to say to Anastasia because he lost to Reid. So he might have felt shame or disgrace, and he was insecure. But Subaru fell into a sleep and then woke up and somehow found a bird. The animation for this bird was like it glowed brightly, so I felt like it was a dream or magic, but it was just animation. He lost the bird but found the feather on the ground at a dead end and found a secret passage and went to a skydeck of the watchtower. Foxidna was there, and started talking with Subaru. He raised his eyebrows to her because she found this passage without saying anything to him, but she also was suspicious of him. She told him that Anastasia was actually trying to find some information about him but couldn't find any before a royal selection. This was a very natural reaction and I was able to imagine it, so this was a good plot. They almost resolved their suspicions, but Julius came to the skydeck too and found out about Foxidna so he knew Anastasia wasn't there since Priestella. Their talk was very rational, despite the fact that he wasn't the first person who knew about Foxidna while he was her first knight. And also, he didn't want to get rid of his first knight because that was the one remaining thing he had, after he became nameless and spirits didn't follow him. That was sad.

Then they left, and Subaru couldn't go back to the green room because Julius and Foxidna were there, so he went upstairs to find a way to fight against Reid. I guessed, he was trying to find a Reid book and try to find how to win.

But, the next scene was that he woke up at the green room, and I was wondering, what? why? King crimson? Then Emilia and Beako talked in front of him with Patrasche and worried about him, but what he was thinking was that they were total strangers and it looked like he was in another world. So that means, he faced Gluttony, and he lost his memories. And the episode ended.

So, what exactly was he trying to do? I thought he was trying to find the Reid's book, but instead, maybe he met Gluttony? Or did he find the book of them? But they were not dead, so there should not have been the book about them? Or he found a book and his memory was lost due to the books' experience? I don't know.

An interesting thing will be that Subaru may expose something that other people don't know because Foxidna or Julius were suspicious about him, but this was the best timing to know him. Also, what happens if he got Return by Death? Does he remember it? Or will he go back to the past but not remember anything? Maybe later, then he needs to figure out what happened. Either way, it seems a fun plot here to think.

Watched the 2nd time. When Shaula said she had waited for the sage for centuries — and that Subaru could too in the centuries ahead — it sounded a little bit sad and scary at the same time. I still cannot get what she really thinks, except her devotion.

Well, also, I shouldn't say this for any anime, but I wondered where they got the food in the watchtower, or how they cooked it. Emilia can use ice magic, but not heat. Who can bake or stew foods there?

In the scene between Foxidna and Julius, the reason why she said she used magic so desperately against Reid and hurt Anastasia was not to lose her asset under a circumstance that Reid could have killed him. It kinda makes sense. I think she was supposed to forget who he was, so she didn't really understand how important he was for Ana. But still, she was with her for a long time and she really loved Ana not to lose Ana. I still didn't get why Ana wanted to be a ruler in the Lugnica, so it will be shared in the following episodes, hopefully in this arc?

On the side of Julius, he was beaten a lot so far as I had thought, but it also hit me hard when he said he didn't want Foxidna or Subaru to think of him as not being worthy of a knight. He had high pride and wanted to accept every single thing that the first knight was supposed to be no matter how desperate his situation was.

item.title: First thoughts after watching Re:Zero season 4 episode 6
item.description:
I watched the Re:Zero season 4 episode 6. I remember the story for season 2 and 3 only a little, but don't remember the details of each character that much.

So this episode is half story and half action. At first, Julius started fighting against the stick swinger. The stick he used is chopsticks and he was able to use it to block Julius's sword completely and even broke it. Anastasia, or Echidna, couldn't keep watching Julius be beaten by him so she decided to help him with her magic, but he could even block them with the chopsticks. She even got a nosebleed from using too much magic and lost consciousness, so I wondered again what made her care for him that much. Anyway, Julius was completely beaten by him without giving him any scratch. And then, he asked who was going to challenge him and Emilia decided to face him. That said, Reid said at first he wouldn't move a single step because it sounded cool. So, she persuaded him to win against him by setting that as a winning condition. And then she used her magic. The memorable scene was she dropped a lot of weapons made of ice to the ground surrounding him, and fought while moving to places where they were and used those weapons. Also these ice weapons could be moved by her magic, so it was exactly like Unlimited Blade Works. Well, he made some lewd attacks but she didn't care and she won at the end. Subaru also was able to follow their battle so he had already a great sense for fighting, actually. However, even though passing him was the way to the next exam, she was the only one who could, so the rest of the people still need to fight him.

Subaru and others went back to the downstairs, and left Julius and Echidna in a spirit's room for healing. Then they talked with Ram and figured it out he was a Reid Astrea, who is the first Sword... Saint? There were actually 3 other characters who are as strong as Reinhard so it sounds interesting to see them in the future, but probably not in this season.

Then Julius woke up and fought against the Reid again, but no match with him and lost it. Reid even insulted him as his style of fighting was boring. Then this episode showed a little bit about the past of Julius and he had the past that he admired his teacher or father but he lost against the kids' Reinhard. It surely beaten him up. But because of that, when he saw Subaru in the royal selection in season 1 at first, he was moved from how Subaru behaved because, well, obviously, he was very powerless but with ambition, and so was he, as far as I understood.

And that is the episode. This arc is probably mainly about Anastasia's side of Royal selection, maybe, because I didn't know the details of Julius and his character, and same thing for Anastasia. So it will have the past episodes for Anastasia and Echidna, perhaps, in this season.

Watched 2nd time. Reid talked about the name Trische looking at Emilia. Who was it? I vaguely remembered that name but maybe that's my misunderstanding. Looking at Reid's fighting scene. As a genius's character often does, he was left-handed, and he used chopsticks for both sides to attack, actually. And one hit didn't beat Julius at all, and also he enjoyed fighting him at a moment right after Echidna lost her consciousness. The BGMs were also exaggerated but good in the scenes where he blew Julius out on the 2nd time, and also when Julius and Subaru went downstairs at the end.

And obviously, Julius and Subaru are alike. They were stubborn, and felt powerless, but still fought against stronger opponents, invincible opponents. That might be the reason why their relationship was good since season 1.

item.title: First thoughts after watching Re:Zero season 4 episode 5
item.description:
I watched the Re:Zero season 4 episode 5. I remember the story for season 2 and 3 only a little, but don't remember the details of each character that much.

At first, Subaru was surprised to pass an exam on the 3rd floor in the Pleiades Watchtower. It was an answer which has no way to know from normal people, so he thinks the person who set it up is pure evil. Then they went to a library with a lot of books. But the books were unreadable, because when they were opened, the characters were moving. Those books were for the past people but that library was too big and not sorted very well. However, when Subaru opened one of books, then he experienced the life of that person. That book was for the Witch of Pride, Typhon. It's a little bit surprising that even Emilia or Beako didn't know the name of the Witch. Only the Witch of Envy was known in this world?

It was not only Subaru but also Julius experienced it. Then somehow Anastasia noticed the Shaula didn't share the rules of exams to them, and asked the rules. Anastasia thought there were 5 rules, but Shaula only answered 4 rules, which forced participants to go through exams until the end. One question they didn't answer was, who Shaula was? She lived for 400 years, and she wasn't a spirit at all, and she didn't even think a spirit is a trivial existence. Is she a mabeast? A demon? not sure.

Shaula was very optimistic, positive, and reacted a lot so she might be fun character to see and write a script.

Meili also talked about her past a little bit and it seems she wasn't really interested in knowing her biological parents. She was raised by mabeasts because she had an ability to manipulate mabeasts since then.

Then somehow, Emilia found the next exam on the 2nd floor, which was not from 3rd floor but from a different floor. How did she notice from a hint that the person who set up the exam was terrible? Was she that smart? I don't remember any episode that she actually was keen to that.

Then the next exam was still in a white room, and there was only one sword standing on the ground like the master sword of the Legend of Zelda. Subaru pulled the sword and then, they moved the place, and another guy, who appears in the opening (OP), came up. Shaula was strongly scared of him, and his hair is red and long, and he is masculine. He said himself as a stick swinger, but I think he was Reid, who was an ancestor of Reinhard, who was the first Sword Saint. Shaula's attitude showed that obviously. Then Julius seemed to fight him as an exam on the next episode. I guess, they'll lose but then, not sure what happens. Let's see what will happen.

Also, the library was very good one as we can often see it in a fantasy world, but I wonder this was only one time thing. It wasn't sorted very well, so they may not find it useful, but hope it'll appear more and more. Maybe Subaru will return by death, try to find the past of each character, and learn them, and find weaknesses to win? Let's see.

Watched 2nd time. I don't get why and how Typhon became the witch. I mean, I understood what happened, but the magic ability was awaken suddenly? Then will this witch be important in this arc?

Also, when Julius was unable to respond to Anastasia after reading a book, she looked very concerned and serious. It was, well, natural, but it sounded like too much concern to me, considering she lost the memory of who he was, and also she was a fox. Maybe she was afraid something bad happened? Actually, in this arc, she is one of the main heroines, considering how short and shallow her involvement was in season 1 and 3 compared to Emilia and Crusch.

The BGMs were, also trying to match scenes, I guess. The scene for the Typhon's past seems like those in medieval to me, and also when they climbed the upstairs for the 2nd floor's exam room, it was a very bright and light sound.

Also, in the white room, the art style changed in a way that important lines are blue instead of black for almost all objects, except some 3d objects like the base stone of the sword. It probably tries to keep the lines from being too noticeable? I wonder what the purpose is.

item.title: First thoughts after watching Re:Zero season 4 episode 4
item.description:
I watched the Re:Zero season 4 episode 4. I remember the story for season 2 and 3 only a little, but don't remember the details of each character that much. Subaru woke up on Emilia's lap at first in their carriage, which was actually in the Pleiades tower. Then everyone is there. I was thinking why? Probably Shaula gathered them or they happened to be there after the end of season 2. But if she gathered, then I think she prioritized Subaru at first, so it's likely the latter case.

Then she thought Subaru is her master, Flugel, because he smelled s***. Some people like Rem hates his smell and from how Shaula said, I think she also hates it so she probably can sense the witch's smell like Rem. Also, she lives for a long time, and seems she is not a human, neither? She said someone died 400 years ago or so, so... what is she? And even though her name is Shaula, it seems she is not the sage. Then Flugel somehow asked her to prevent anyone from coming to the tower and she obeyed all along, but why? So, I assume there is something too strong or too useful in the tower like other fantasy story does. By the way, everyone doesn't know "Flugel" except that the person who planted a large tree was the one Subaru defeated the white whale with in the past.

Then, Subaru went to a room with spirits, where looks like a jungle. And Patrasche was there because the room has a healing effect to them. Rem was also there but Rem couldn't be cured because her state wasn't an injury nor mind issue. Ram decided to be there to take care of Rem.

Then Subaru went to the 4th floor, which is the first exam of the tower to enter into a library of the tower. Subaru found the monolith, which looks like a stone of which height was the similar as humans, and when he touched, the exam started. The exam was to start appearing the number of monoliths and they needed to find the right monolith. While he was thinking and talking with his friends, he noticed by looking at the Shaula and her hair. She said before that her hair style was not a pony tail, but a scorpion tail, and that made him realized that the exam was about the constellation. This made me think, did someone come from another world besides Subaru? And because they came from another world, that they had the smell of the witch, and was it Flugel?

Anyhow, Subaru found the right monolith and went to a library and ended the episode.

After watching the 2nd time, it made me think a few things. Shaula guarded the watchtower to protect the Great Pleiades Library, and that library and the tower was built by Flugel. It appears he has a strong authority or magic power to build it. Also, she likes her scorpion hair and also her hair pin is with a star. She has a memory or something for that hair. Beako worried about how Shaula would behave if she found out Subaru isn't Flugel. Especially Flugel ordered her not to talk to anyone, which Subaru said he was a terrible person to do so, so maybe she knows something important.

Then, Reid, who was the first Saint, was a scumbag and Shaula was beaten by him. Maybe, Subaru will travel in the past and meet with them, just like other fantasy does.

Then, this episode also showed how Subaru's basic ability is high. He has a lot of knowledge for a myth, and a constellation.

Most of this episode is for story, and didn't notice the details of animation or music that much.

item.title: First thoughts after watching Re:Zero season 4 episode 3
item.description:
I watched the Re:Zero season 4 episode 3. I remember the story for season 2 and 3 only a little, but don't remember the details of each character that much. At the last episode, Subaru and others fell down from the flower's fields. Subaru, Ram, Anastasia, and Patrasche arrived at the underground of the dune. He obviously saved Ram while falling down to the dune.

At first, he was anxious about Rem and lost his temper because if she is alone, she cannot do anything and be hurt. But Ram was chill and she tried to make him calm down. But at that point, they went nuts, and started killing each others. At first, Subaru and Ram. Then once Ram was killed by Anastasia, then he freaked out and was scared, so he overreacted. Then Anastasia was killed by Ram, probably. Then Patrasche killed Ram and then did him. The whole scene was insane and grotesque, especially the scene where Anastasia's lower body was cut and intestines were dropped.

item.title: First thoughts after watching Re:Zero season 4 episode 2
item.description:
I watched the Re:Zero season 4 episode 2. I remember the story for season 2 and 3 only a little, but don't remember the details of each character that much. This episode reminds me of Re:Zero and got me excited a little. Subaru and Emilia went to a pub and heard a rumor about the dune surrounding the Pleiades's tower. They said flying birds in the dune always go to the tower.

Then in the dune, there is a sandstorm. Stronger sandstorm than I thought, which makes even the tower harder to see. Then they left the sandstorm and arrived at the flower field. At this point, they went more than Reinhard could do. But then, there are bear Mabeasts in the field and many of them started chasing Subaru and others. Then, bang! Subaru's return by death started.

Until this return by death, all people joined in the group helped each other. Ram used Mabeast's eyes to find which way they should go by each Mabeast, Meili used a giant sandworm to remove hostile Mabeasts, and also tried to make the bear's Mabeasts go away in the flower fields. But the Joseph, Subaru's carriage's Mabeast, suddenly cried out and she failed to do so. Then of course, Emilia, Beako, and Julius attacked against Mabeasts attacking the carriage. I forgot, but surprisingly, Subaru can use more magic than he used to. Maybe I simply don't remember what he was able to do and learn during Season 3.

Why did the Joseph cry when the bears tried to leave them? Maybe they are afraid of them and want to eliminate instead of leaving? No idea if this is some kinds of important plots or just a random thing.

Anyway, after the return by death, Subaru was panic, which makes sense, and tried to avoid the death by going to a different direction on the 2nd time while fleeing from bears Mabeasts. But he noticed there was a light coming from the tower and crashed them and killed Joseph or Beako. Then on the 3rd try, he used his dark magic and prevented their Mabeast from crying out, and stayed in a place, but then the light still tried to attack Subaru. All of them, especially Julius, put that fall down and protected Subaru. We know he is strong since season 1, but shutting down the blazing-fast object by a sword was really good. Then Subaru used his magic to nullify the object but triggered breaking a barrier, and a hole opened beneath them and they fell down, and ended the episode.

By the way, Julius said Subaru was the one who knows him the most, but did he? Ignoring nameless thing, he is an elite knight and for sure he has more friends. Oh, but during the season 1, he said Subaru is his best friend, so kinda make sense. Considering that early, he might not have many friends in knights, or those knights were not alive, or he was promoted too early to Anastasia's knight and they left.

Watching 2nd time, I missed a lot about a few things. First, Julius stroked Joseph's chin on the early scene and he calmed them down, which helped Subaru to do the same on the later scene. Also, Julius lost an ability to use his spirits, so fights and putting the light down was by his physical ability only. Also, Emilia ordered hot milk in a desert in the day. Is there any background that she actually can protect from the heat because she can use ice magics? Then Ram's left eye was bleeding when the light was coming from the Tower, but why? She cannot use her ability because it's for mabeasts but not others, so by what?

Anyway, let's see what's going to happen in the next episode.

item.title: First thoughts after watching Re:Zero season 4 episode 1
item.description:
I watched the Re:Zero season 4 episode 1. In the last season, Subaru fought against multiple Sin Archbishops with royal candidates of Lugunica's next ruler and their knights. And in the season, Julius was forgotten by everyone by the end. Also, Subaru got a dragon's cursed leg and arm instead of flesh.

It started with a scene where they met outside and talked about him, confirming that everyone except Subaru had forgotten him. Then Anastasia suggested to meet with the Sage in Lugunica, Shaula. They are the one of the greatest heroes: the sword saint, who is obviously Reinhard, Dragon lord, I don't know who, and the Saint. The saint could save him from the nameless state, which was the curse of Gluttony. It's the 1st time hearing that Saint and wondered what he did for an entire time. It seems the Sage keeps their eyes on the seal for the Witch, obviously, but then what does Dragon lord do?

Anyway, partway through the journey, Subaru suddenly realized that Anastasia is not actually herself. She is Echidna, which happens to be the same name as Echidona, the Witch of Greed, but the different. She is a fox in the fur worn by Anastasia, and she was an artificial spirit. I was a little bit confused, from when she became Echidna, or Foxidna? After season 4? Or was she actually from season 3? At least Priscilla noticed her too, so perhaps during season 3 but I forgot. But she wasn't hostile, so it's probably not a big issue.

Then Subaru and others arrived at the Mansion of Roswaal's and met with a few people there. And then he tried to pick up Rem because the saint could save her like Julius, too. Subaru talked to Rem. That scene really pretends to show like she is a main heroine in this series. But at least it shows how Subaru is greedy that he wants to save everyone and also thinks Rem is special to him, though Emilia is the first.

Then he also met a girl. I think she was on the season 1 who uses wolves to attack a Roswaal's village. I didn't expect her to appear again and also started going with them. But the place where the Saint lives sounds like surrounding by the Mabeasts, and she can use them, so that's why he needed helps from her.

Then at the last, Garfield met with his mom, who forgot who he is and then told him her kids' names, which turned out to be Frederica and Garfield. Then Garfield was satisfied with his mom, perhaps because he wasn't forgotten completely and he missed her a lot. He is actually 15 or 16 if I remember correctly, and he was without his parents, so it's touching scene.

This episode is just a start, and it tried to show a lot of scenes here and there. Let's see what's going to happen, and when a loop will start.
